title: Design System: 街拍相机 · Soft Android

caption.purpose: Compact camera controls and supporting copy.

zoom-readout.purpose: Current zoom on the native right-edge gesture ruler.

shadows.name: status-legibility
shadows.value: Android TextView.setShadowLayer: radius 3dp, dx 0dp, dy 1dp, black
shadows.purpose: Local status-text contrast over live imagery.

motion.name: search-cycle
motion.value: 1800ms linear angle derived from uptime; disabled animation draws a static arc

motion.name: automatic-framing
motion.value: Log zoom interpolation; s(t)=10t^3-15t^4+6t^5; duration max(0.5,1.05*abs(ln(goal/start))) seconds.
motion.purpose: One continuous, interruptible framing move; freezes on tracking loss/misalignment; immediate target when system animations are disabled.

motion.name: gesture-zoom-response
motion.value: Exponential response coefficient 70/s in log zoom.
motion.purpose: Smooth small touch steps while preserving direct control.

motion.name: preset-zoom-response
motion.value: Critically damped response coefficient 14/s in log zoom.

native.dimensionUnits: dp and sp; sidecar samples use 1 CSS px per native unit for visual inspection only
native.previewStates: Native uses RippleDrawable and platform focus semantics; CSS focus rings are preview-only keyboard affordances.
native.tonalRamps: Synthesized OKLCH inspection ramps; not additional application tokens.

freeCrop.aspectRatio: Independent retained width and height; no fixed ratio constraints.
freeCrop.outline: 1dp camera-mint over 3dp dark contrast stroke, Android Color.argb(100, 8, 27, 19).
freeCrop.cornerMarks: 2dp camera-mint; length min(12dp, shorter frame dimension / 4).
freeCrop.visibility: Active proposed frame or centered retained crop; completed retained outline persists after guidance ends. No outside scrim.
freeCrop.caption: 自由裁切 when either retained dimension < 0.999.
freeCrop.output: Centered saved region with rotation-aware width/height mapping.

compositionArrow.geometry: Straight shaft using Path.lineTo; rounded stroke caps.
compositionArrow.head: 14dp axial length, perpendicular spread 0.6 times that length.
compositionArrow.color: Existing camera-mint; Android Color.rgb(166, 228, 189) when ready.
compositionArrow.meaning: Arrow indicates phone movement, rather than subject movement.

zoomRuler.track: Log-spaced 1/2/4/8 ticks within supported range; rail starts at 45dp and ends 30dp above bottom.
zoomRuler.state: Mint active fill 3dp / thumb radius 6dp; idle 2dp / 4.5dp.
zoomRuler.input: Relative log-fraction drag; plus/minus multiply/divide 1.15; accessibility multiply/divide 1.1 or set-progress.
zoomRuler.semantics: Native SeekBar range and state description.
zoomRuler.specimen: Static 2× visual example with press/focus state; native Android source owns actual range interaction.

native.artisticDiscoveryPresentation: One short subject label and reason in existing status text. Ranking combines subjective artistic/story/geometric/clarity estimates; it is not an objective quality grade or a visible score system.

narrative.overview:
Soft Android treats the live image as the main material. Small rounded controls float on charcoal backings; white camera controls and mint guidance remain consistent in day and night. Auxiliary dialogs use quiet neutral surfaces that follow the system theme.

The visual character is gentle, compact and familiar to phone-camera users. Native Android Views, system sans typography, geometric drawn icons and restrained depth carry the interface. AI guidance assists the photographer while the manual shutter remains the capture control.
keyCharacteristics: Full-screen image with compact edge controls.
Mint selection, white capture affordance and local charcoal contrast.
Rounded native controls and neutral day/night dialogs.
Local guidance motion with system animation settings respected.

rules.name: Local Contrast
rules.body: Camera labels use their own charcoal backing; contrast support belongs to the control, rather than an opaque panel over the image.

rules.name: Native Type
rules.body: Use system sans for native controls and supporting copy; the camera has no display typography layer.

rules.name: Image First
rules.body: Keep the viewfinder full-screen and let controls float at its edges. Auxiliary sheets and settings dialogs open only for their task.

rules.name: Quiet Depth
rules.body: Use tonal separation and native ripple feedback for controls; reserve dark strokes and text shadow for legibility over live imagery.

dos: Do use the camera palette for live-view controls in both system themes.
Do preserve the familiar shutter silhouette and keep AI composition immediately beside it.
Do keep interactive camera controls at least 48dp and respect system insets.
Do use the day/night dialog palette for auxiliary tasks.
Do retain local search animation and its static fallback when system animation is disabled.
donts: Don't put the live viewfinder inside a card or add opaque top/bottom control panels.
Don't replace the manual shutter with an AI-triggered capture action.
Don't introduce a display face, decorative typography or hardware imitation into this Soft world.
Don't treat OPPO functional composition inspiration as authorization for a pixel copy.
